pages.text: I can scatter flowers that do not belong to the local climate.

$(bold)Mana:$() ½ bucket$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)Aim at terrain within eight blocks. The spell tests positions in a six-block sphere and randomly places valid flowers with a twenty-two percent chance per eligible position. The candidate list includes ordinary flowers from many biomes and Torchflowers.
